items.title: Bennie Turner Interview, 1972-02-09
items.q: Was he akin to Robert Davis?

ctx.x: Yeah, Jimmy. Jimmy Davis. That was Jimmy Davis' brother playing the drum at the computer with the power of this.
Was he akin to Robert Davis? I think that's his name.
Robert Davis was a drummer, yeah. Okay, before we leave La Vida, let's check it again, huh?
